title: reMaestro plugin submission
description: One of these lives at plugins/<id>/plugin.json and is the whole submission. Unknown fields are rejected rather than ignored: a field we do not understand is a claim we cannot check. There is deliberately no tier, badge or verification field here and there never will be: a tier a publisher writes into their own submission is one they have asserted rather than one anybody checked, and 'additionalProperties: false' is what makes that refusal structural rather than a rule somebody has to remember. Tiers are resolved from verification/ and from tools/registry/policy.py — see docs/verification.md.

id.description: Reverse-DNS, lowercase, allocated once and never reassigned. Must equal the directory name.

summary.description: One line, shown in the list. No marketing claims about safety or review — see CONTRIBUTING.md.

description.description: Longer prose for the plugin's page. Plain text or CommonMark.

publisher.description: The id of a record in publishers/. Set on first publication and never changed — an id that changes hands is an entitlement pointing at different software.

kind.description: What the hub does with it. Only 'driver' exists today.

license.description: SPDX identifier. Required from the first submission even though only free licences are accepted today, because adding a required field later invalidates every published manifest.

source.description: Where the source lives. Checked that it resolves; never checked that the archives were built from it — see README.md.

versions.description: Append-only. A published version is never edited or removed; it is withdrawn.

abi.description: The driver.proto protocol version this build was made against. One integer per version, the same across every architecture — if two architectures disagree they are different software.

runtime.description: What the box must already have. 'native' is a self-contained or static executable; 'python3' is present on the appliance and in the container. Node is on neither, so a Node plugin ships as 'native'.

archives.description: One archive per architecture, keyed by runtime identifier. A box downloads its own and only its own.

unsupportedRids.description: An architecture this version deliberately has no build for, and why. Saying so explicitly is what stops 'we forgot' looking like 'we decided'.

withdrawn.description: The kill switch. Marks a version as no longer offered; the hub warns about it where it is installed. It cannot uninstall anything, and must not be able to.

url.description: Absolute https URL to a gzipped tar. Absolute rather than relative to the index, so an artifact can later move behind an authenticated endpoint without the install path changing.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the archive bytes. 64 characters; anything else cannot be a hash.

size.description: Bytes. Lets a hub refuse an oversized artifact before downloading it.

signature.description: Base64 of a detached ECDSA P-256 signature over SHA-256 of the archive bytes, DER-encoded. Made by the publisher, never by us.

keyId.description: Which of the publisher's pinned keys signed it.
